solutions.title: BFS coordinate conversion
solutions.strategy: Run BFS over square numbers and convert each candidate destination to board coordinates on demand.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most n^2 squares are visited, with up to six edges checked per square.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The visited set and queue can store all board squares.

solutions.title: Precomputed destinations
solutions.strategy: Flatten the board into destination squares first, then run BFS over that one-dimensional graph.

timeComplexity.explanation: Flattening and BFS each touch the board-sized square set.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The destination array, visited array, and queue are board-sized.
